issue.title: Full CI visual-test red: 7 Statistics pane PNG goldens drifted after the project language breakdown (ba59799ce9)
issue.description:
Full CI is red on master HEAD 60832648be (run 40347322042, 2026-10-26): the
`full / visual-test` job fails `just fix-tui-screenshots` drift with
`counts: created=0 updated=7 unchanged=1119 stale=0`. All 7 drifting goldens are the
Admin Center Statistics pane PNGs in
`tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_statistics.py`:

- config_center_statistics_projects_120x40.png
- config_center_statistics_projects_narrow_90x30.png
- config_center_statistics_help_120x40.png
- the projects_model / projects_repo / projects_patch / projects_single scenes

Found during the 2026-10-26 task-bead backlog triage; the CI-bead triage helper also
reproduced all 7 failures locally (TZ=UTC -m visual), with 4-9% of pixels changed on
the Projects views. The previous Full CI green was 7423fa8380 (2026-10-25).

Likely cause: ba59799ce9 (2026-10-25, "feat(stats): add project language breakdown
with rows card and repo LANGUAGE column") and its follow-ups ce75abd76f / 49b1b9088b
changed the Statistics Projects rendering (src/sase/stats/render/*) without
regenerating the Statistics pane PNG goldens. None of these came from an epic phase.

Fix: inspect the actual/expected/diff artifacts and confirm the drift is exactly the
intended language-breakdown/LANGUAGE-column change (not a layout regression). Then
regenerate only those goldens through the visual-maintenance path (`just
fix-tui-screenshots`, TZ=UTC), run the Statistics visual file, and confirm a fresh Full CI
visual-test is green. Full CI is a ci_watch release prerequisite, so this blocks
releases.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic golden drift: Full CI run 40347322042 at 60832648be reports updated=7 for exactly the config_center_statistics_* goldens, and the triage helper reproduced all 7 locally under TZ=UTC -m visual. The goldens predate ba59799ce9, which changed the Statistics Projects rendering.
